tagline: Managed platforms, durable execution engines and agent servers where AI agents live, keep state and run for long.
scope: It is about hosting and running agents over time, not a code sandbox or an agent framework with no runtime.
heroAlt: Animated isometric scene: a clock hand sweeps a building of agent rooms, lighting each room in turn while its agent works, and every finished room sends a state packet along a wire into a cabinet drawer that fills card by card.
